description: Header file defining the VideoOutputPortType class, which extends DSConstant and manages video output port configurations, supported resolutions, and related properties within a device settings namespace.

classes.name: VideoOutputPortType
classes.description: Class extending DSConstant to implement video output port type configurations, including supported resolutions, port types, and HDCP/DTCP support flags.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve singleton instance of VideoOutputPortType by id or name.

methods.name: getTypeId
methods.description: Returns the type identifier of the port type.

methods.name: isDynamicResolutionsSupported
methods.description: Checks if dynamic resolutions are supported.

methods.name: getSupportedResolutions
methods.description: Returns a list of supported video resolutions.

methods.name: getOutputResolution
methods.description: Returns the output resolution for a given input resolution.

methods.name: getPorts
methods.description: Returns the list of available video output ports.

methods.name: enabledHDCP
methods.description: Enables HDCP support with optional content protection and DHCP key.
